verdict.rationale: Zulip's documented bot framework lets you write/run custom bots (or existing ones) that react to messages, run via Botserver, which is the underlying mechanism needed to add an AI agent as a channel member that responds to mentions — but the evidence never mentions AI/LLM agents specifically, mention-triggered behavior, or any first-party AI integration example. Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent/LLM bot examples, documented @mention-triggering behavior, and independent/hands-on confirmation of an AI bot working this way in a channel.
